_doc: Secret realms (W-005, SecretRealms). Each realm opens every period_years years, first at offset_years after the game starts, and stays open open_days days. Only cultivators from min_realm to max_realm (realms.json ids) pass its barrier, and only from its region (regions.json id). entry_stones: spirit stones paid on the first entry of each opening. floors are cleared in order, one per entry, and progress resets at the next opening. Per floor: name, text, days (time spent), guardian (enemies.json id or ""; it must be beaten to claim the floor), treasures: [{weight, effects}] (one is drawn per floor; effects use the shared Effects keys, items/qi recommended); a floor's days must be fewer than open_days. W-005d: a floor that would last past the realm's closing casts the delver out with no treasure after the days left, inflicting the optional expulsion_injury (injuries.json id). Optional inheritance {name, text, min_comprehension, effects}: granted once per life when the last floor is cleared, if the delver's Comprehension is at least min_comprehension (otherwise they may try again at a later opening); effects use the shared Effects keys, usually learn_technique.

realms.name: Verdant Remnant
realms.description: The drifting pocket garden of a fallen herb sect, which surfaces in the Misty Forest for two months every few years.

inheritance.name: Legacy of the Verdant Sect
inheritance.text: Among the pavilion's roots a jade slip pulses with green light, and the breathing art of a whole lost sect flows into your mind.

floors.name: Overgrown Gardens
floors.text: Spirit herbs choke the old terraces, and something grey stalks between them.

floors.name: Collapsed Library
floors.text: Shelves of rotted bamboo slips. Another treasure hunter got here first, and does not intend to share.

floors.name: Heart Pavilion
floors.text: At the garden's heart a stone ape guards a pavilion still thick with qi.

realms.name: Sunken Sword Tomb
realms.description: Once a decade the mists over Azure Peak part to reveal the tomb of a sword immortal's disciples.

inheritance.name: Sword Master's Inheritance
inheritance.text: As the python falls, the coffin's lid slides aside. A last strand of sword intent left by the tomb's master tests your heart, and finds it worthy.

floors.name: Hall of Broken Blades
floors.text: A stone guardian still patrols among a thousand shattered swords.

floors.name: Blood-Stained Corridor
floors.text: A demonic cultivator has been feeding on the trapped souls here.

floors.name: Sword Master's Coffin
floors.text: A jade python has coiled itself around the coffin of the tomb's master.
